zh.title: FAA擬罰TiendaMIA 77750美元危險品違規
zh.summary: FAA擬罰TiendaMIA 77750美元因危險品違規
body: 美國聯邦航空總署（FAA）宣布擬對TiendaMIA Xipron公司處以77,750美元民事罰款，理由是該公司涉嫌違反美國運輸部危險品運輸規定。
FAA指稱，2024年11月TiendaMIA向貨運代理提供未申報貨物，內含EcoFlow River 2便攜電源，裝有256瓦時鋰離子電池，屬危險品。
貨運代理隨後將貨物轉交Avianca Cargo Air以航空運輸，但缺乏必要危險品文件、分類、包裝、標記及標簽，且TiendaMIA未提供緊急響應資訊及員工培訓。公司有30天回應。

en.title: FAA Proposes $77,750 Fine Against TiendaMIA Xipron for Hazardous Materials Violations
en.summary: FAA proposes $77,750 fine against TiendaMIA Xipron for hazardous materials violations
body: The Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) has proposed a $77,750 civil penalty against TiendaMIA Xipron, Inc., of Medley, Florida, for allegedly violating U.S. Department of Transportation hazardous materials regulations.

The agency alleges that in November 2024 TiendaMIA offered a freight broker an undeclared shipment containing EcoFlow River 2 portable power stations with 256‑watt‑hour lithium‑ion batteries, which are classified as hazardous material. The broker forwarded the shipment to Avianca Cargo Air for air transport.

The FAA says the shipment lacked required hazardous materials documentation and was not properly classed, described, packaged, marked, labeled, or conditioned for shipment. TiendaMIA also failed to provide emergency response information and to train employees who prepare hazmat shipments. The company has 30 days to respond.

zh.title: EASA公布2026創新空中交通論壇議程
zh.summary: EASA公布2026 IAM論壇議程；10月27至28日於科隆舉行
body: 歐洲航空安全局（EASA）於9月10日公布2026年創新空中交通（IAM）實施論壇的最新議程，包括主要講者的詳細資訊。論壇將於2026年10月27至28日在科隆的EASA總部及線上舉行。
本次論壇主題為「從規則到現實：加速歐洲的創新空中交通」，將匯聚主管機關、業界、技術專家及更廣泛的IAM社群，聚焦於歐洲創新性空中交通的實務執行。
活動議程圍繞三大主軸：U-space、垂直起降（VTOL）及無人飛機系統（UAS），並包含小組討論、工作坊及互動討論。討論主題包括U-space簡化、eVTOL驗證與投入服務、超越目視飛行線（BVLOS）及跨境UAS操作、自動化與安全等內容。

en.title: EASA releases agenda for 2026 Innovative Air Mobility Implementation Forum
en.summary: EASA publishes agenda for IAM Implementation Forum, Oct 27-28 in Cologne and online
body: The European Union Aviation Safety Agency (EASA) published on 10 September the updated agenda for the 2026 Innovative Air Mobility (EAM) Implementation Forum, including details of key speakers. The Forum is scheduled to take place on 27-28 October 2026 at EASA Headquarters in Cologne and online.

Under the theme, the second edition of the Forum will bring together authorities, industry, technical experts and the wider community to focus on power and dynamics of implementing operationality the newsletter in Europe.
The programme is structured around three main levels - and, in and upon - with panels, workshops and discussions exploring topics that will drive the future and ensure the finalization of services.
